title: a new child-process call without windowsHide
how: a spawn / spawnSync / execFile / execFileSync / exec / execSync call (bare, or child_process.x without exec: RegExp has one) with no windowsHide property in its arguments. Each such call can flash a console window on Windows; the flag is ignored elsewhere. Options passed as a variable or a spread need the flag written in the call

selectors.message: a child process without windowsHide: add windowsHide: true to its options
